parsed.why: Moderate-risk tier, no adult facility ban but no division-level nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage for visitors; board-driven restrictions and municipal patchwork leave exposure roughly at parent level with no protective offset.

Most-protective tier with enforced public-accommodations nondiscrimination since 2003, self-ID documents with X marker, shield law, hate-crime coverage, and gender-neutral single-occupancy restrooms — strong division-level protections offsetting hostile national framework.

Most-protective tier with comprehensive nondiscrimination, hate-crime coverage, self-declared documents, shield law, and conversion-therapy ban; unrepealed dead-letter sodomy statute and national passport/entry regime cap the score slightly below Dossier 2.

Worst-law tier: first state to strip gender-identity nondiscrimination (2025), barred localities from stronger protections, school facilities rule binding all adults including visitors; division adds hostile layer beneath already-restrictive parent framework.

Most-protective tier with nondiscrimination since 2001 covering public accommodations, hate-crime enhancements, shield laws, X marker, self-declaration document change, panic-defense repeal; national-layer erosion acknowledged but division protections actively operate for visitors.
